label: REUNION
episode: SEASON 4 · REUNION SPECIAL · "EVERYONE BROUGHT A LAWYER"
tone: Live-TV chaos. Receipts, betrayals, and a host who is delighted by all of it.

tabloid_confessed.recap: You declared yourself the tabloid, live.

second_couch.recap: You produced a second, smaller couch from your purse.

lawyer_swapped.recap: You fired your lawyer on air.

start.narration: Seven women, one couch, and a host with a clipboard full of receipts. A lawyer is hiding under the coffee table. Possibly yours.
start.speaker: HOST CHAD BELLAMY-OKAFOR
start.line: Let's talk about the night of the goat. Somebody sold a story to a tabloid. Somebody sold it twice. Somebody sold it to a goat.
start.confessional: I have never read a script. I have only read the room, and the room is on fire.

choices.text: Stand up and declare yourself the tabloid.
choices.hint: The couch reacts. Chad is thrilled. Escalate.

choices.text: Slowly pull a second, smaller couch out of your purse.
choices.hint: Nobody knows what the second couch is for. Chad has questions.

choices.text: Fire your lawyer, live, and hire the one under the table.
choices.hint: The lawyer under the table has been listening this whole time.

endings.title: You Host Next Season
endings.text: Chad has been 'reassigned to a smaller couch.' You get the clipboard.

endings.title: Renewed, Pending Legal
endings.text: You're back next season, subject to a 40-page agreement about the goat.

endings.title: Cut From the Edit
endings.text: Every scene you were in was 'reimagined.' You can be seen in the background, holding a fountain.
